{{Quote|I don't know how they picked Okator VIII. It doesn't really matter, I suppose. It could have been a lot of places in the Divide. They could have picked Matabre, or Ilamna or Cortilium Major. But they didn't. They picked Okator.|Baragwin sense lattice imprinted by a Republic soldier|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
'''Cortilium Major''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located in the [[Cortilium Major system/Legends|Cortilium Major system]], a part of the [[Eucer sector/Legends|Eucer sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Tionese War]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> waged between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]],<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Cortilium Major was situated in the region known as [[the Divide]] and was settled by Republic [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

Shortly before the war's end<ref name="Author's Cut" /> around [[23,900 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> a [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] military force [[Attack on Okator VIII|destroyed]] Republic settlements on the celestial body [[Okator VIII]]. [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Falang Minor)|One]] witness of the attack, a local [[Farmer/Legends|farm boy]]&ndash;turned&ndash;[[Republic soldier]], later narrated an account of the attack in a [[Baragwin sense lattice]], noting that the Tionese could have just as well chosen as their target any of the other settled astronomical objects of the Divide, including Cortilium Major.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cortilium Major was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the astronomical object was cut before the book's release.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The information regarding Cortilium Major was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Cortilium Major [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square Q-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
